samples.xml_description:
Design an FSM that detects the sequence 10011 in a single-bit input IN. Input signal to the FSM. Clock signal. Reset signal. Output signal indicating a match condition based on the FSM state. 0. Initial state. Detect the 0th MSB 1. 1. State detecting 1th bit 0. 2. State detecting 2th bit 0. 3. State detecting 3th bit 1. 4. State detecting 4th LSB 1. 5. State detecting 2th bit 0. This case is check sequences with successive bits `1, 0, 0, 1, 1` such: 1, 0, 0, 1, `1, 0, 0, 1, 1` . MATCH: combinational logic. If RST is active, the output signal MATCH is set to 0. Otherwise, MATCH is active if the current state ST_cr is s4 and the input IN is active. assign MATCH = (ST_cr == s4) & IN; ST_cr: sequential logic. This logic updates FSM state based on ST_nt. Based on positive CLK and positive RST, if RST is active, ST_cr is s0, else ST_cr is ST_nt. always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin if (RST) begin ST_cr <= s0; end else begin ST_cr <= ST_nt; end end ST_nt: combinational logic. This logic selects next state of FSM based on the input IN. In case ST_cr is s0, ST_nt is s0, if IN is zero, else ST_nt is s1. In case ST_cr is s1, ST_nt is s2, if IN is zero, else ST_nt is s1. In case ST_cr is s2, ST_nt is s3, if IN is zero, else ST_nt is s1. In case ST_cr is s3, ST_nt is s0, if IN is zero, else ST_nt is s4. In case ST_cr is s4, ST_nt is s2, if IN is zero, else ST_nt is s5. In case ST_cr is s5, ST_nt is s2, if IN is zero, else ST_nt is s1. assign ST_nt = (ST_cr == s0) ? ((IN == 0) ? s0 : s1) : (ST_cr == s1) ? ((IN == 0) ? s2 : s1) : (ST_cr == s2) ? ((IN == 0) ? s3 : s1) : (ST_cr == s3) ? ((IN == 0) ? s0 : s4) : (ST_cr == s4) ? ((IN == 0) ? s2 : s5) : (ST_cr == s5) ? ((IN == 0) ? s2 : s1) : ST_cr; The module implements an FSM detection.
  • Reset condition: When RST is active, the FSM resets to the initial state (s0) and MATCH is set to 0.
  • State transitions: The FSM transitions between states based on the input IN and the current state (ST_cr).
  • Output generation: The MATCH output is set to 1 when the FSM reaches state s4 and IN is active.
